decision_owner: deterministic detector plus ClickHouse SQL; human QC owns action

judge_contrast.positive_luminance: a rendition that introduced a general flash its master never had
judge_contrast.positive_red: a rendition that introduced a saturated-red flash while luminance stayed under the general-flash floor
judge_contrast.control_inherited: titles whose master already violates; the rendition introduced nothing and must be excluded
judge_contrast.control_clean: renditions of a clean master, which must return nothing
